mapper.select: SELECT T.id, T.token_vl AS token, T.token_type, T.dscd_yn AS revok, T.expry_yn AS exp, T.user_id, U.user_id as user_id_string, U.eml as email FROM SYS_TOKEN T LEFT JOIN SYS_USER U ON T.user_id = U.id WHERE T.token_vl = #{token}
SELECT id, token_vl AS token, token_type, dscd_yn AS revok, expry_yn AS exp, user_id FROM SYS_TOKEN WHERE user_id = #{auth_user.id} AND expry_yn = #{exp} AND dscd_yn = #{revok}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SYS_TOKEN( id, expry_yn, dscd_yn, user_id, token_vl, token_type )VALUES( #{id}, #{exp}, #{revok}, #{auth_user.id}, #{token}, #{token_type} )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM SYS_TOKEN WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (expry_yn = 1 OR dscd_yn = 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE SYS_TOKEN SET expry_yn = 1, dscd_yn = 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND expry_yn = 0 AND dscd_yn = 0
